description: This Java class 'FtlWriter' processes FreeMarker Template Language (FTL) templates, rendering them to Appendable outputs. It manages template environments, processes template strings, and handles rendering of various RenderableFtl objects via a visitor pattern.

classes.name: FtlWriter
classes.description: A utility class for processing and rendering FreeMarker templates, including handling template environments and rendering RenderableFtl objects.

methods.name: FtlWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the macro library template and visual theme.

methods.name: processFtl
methods.description: Processes a RenderableFtl object as a template and writes the output to the provided Appendable.

methods.name: processFtlString
methods.description: Processes an FTL string as a template and writes the output to the provided Appendable, with optional locale.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a FreeMarker Environment associated with the Appendable, setting the locale.
